game.title: Galaxy
game.tagline: Your goal is to find your way back home while navigating through asteroid fields, encountering alien lifeforms, and blasting enemy ships!
description: Paper Apps™ GALAXY is the third game in the Paper Apps™ series of procedurally-generated game notebooks.

Solo roll-and-write gameplay
Each notebook is uniquely generated
60-page, 3x5" coil-bound notepad
Works with a d6 or our Pencil Dice
Here's the breakdown of what you can expect to find in each notebook:

Title page
Rules (6 pages)
System Map
Ship Upgrades
Game Stats
Sectors:
Levels (40 pages)
Encounters (6 pages)
Monster battles (3 pages)
You Win! Page
Add that all up and you've got 60 pages of galactic adventure, all in the palm of your hand. With each level taking from 5-10 minutes to complete, each notebook should provide several hours of fun!

rules:
# {{title}} rules

You need this notebook and a pencil. Play with 2 to 6 players.

## Setup

1. **First step.** Say what players do before the first round.
2. **Second step.** Keep each step short.

## Playing a round

1. **Do this.** One idea per step.
2. **Then this.** Bold the name of the step.
3. **Score it.** Say where in the notebook the score is written.

## Winning

Say how the game ends and who wins.

> **Tip.** A box like this calls out an example or an exception.
